flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Consumer Durables is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.80) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

strengths.point: Promoters hold a controlling majority - skin in the game.
Promoters have been adding to their stake.
Consumer Durables is in a tailwind - the macro backdrop is supportive.
The promoter holding trend has been rising for 4 quarters in a row.
strengths.evidence: Promoter Holding trend (quarterly): Increasing for 4 quarters

strengths.point: The stock has beaten its benchmark over the past year.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
The price sits below its long-term moving average.
weaknesses.evidence: Price below the 50-DMA and below the 200-DMA

weaknesses.point: Foreign institutions have been cutting their stake.
Domestic institutions have been cutting their stake.

opportunities.point: A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Promoter holding keeps climbing - the buying has not stopped.
opportunities.evidence: Promoter Holding trend (quarterly): Increasing for 4 quarters

opportunities.point: Continued promoter buying signals confidence in what is coming.

threats.point: Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -1.71 pp, DII -0.97 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.

swot.verdict: No quadrant dominates - strengths, weaknesses carry equal weight (S8/W8/O4/T7), so the evidence does not favour one side.
